iti27:2.1: Yāni kānici bhikkhave opadhikāni puññakiriyavatthūni sabbāni tāni mettāya cetovimuttiyā kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ,
iti27:2.2: mettā yeva tāni cetovimutti adhiggahetvā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca.
iti27:3.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave yā kāci tārakarūpānaṃ pabhā sabbā tā candiyā pabhāya kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ, candappabhā yeva tā adhiggahetvā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca,
iti27:3.2: evam-eva kho bhikkhave yāni kānici opadhikāni puññakiriyavatthūni sabbāni tāni mettāya cetovimuttiyā kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ, mettā yeva tāni cetovimutti adhiggahetvā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca.
iti27:4.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye visuddhe vigatavalāhake nabhe ādicco nabhaṃ abbhussakkamāno sabbaṃ ākāsagataṃ tamagataṃ abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca,
iti27:4.2: evam-eva kho bhikkhave yāni kānici opadhikāni puññakiriyavatthūni sabbāni tāni mettāya cetovimuttiyā kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ, mettā yeva tāni cetovimutti adhiggahetvā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca.
iti27:5.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ osadhitārakā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca,
iti27:5.2: evam-eva kho bhikkhave yāni kānici opadhikāni puññakiriyavatthūni sabbāni tāni mettāya cetovimuttiyā kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ, mettā yeva tāni cetovimutti adhiggahetvā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati cā-ti.
iti27:11.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||7||
iti27:13.5: niṭṭhito, dve dhamme anukkaṭi. 28. (Duk. I.1) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ
